name: Bambu Lab H2S
startScript:
M220 S100 ; reset the speed override
M221 S100 ; reset the flow override — Grackle's E values are the truth
M975 S1 ; vibration compensation on
M106 P1 S0 ; part fan off until a Fan operation asks otherwise
M140 S{bedTemp:.0f} ; bed heating while the machine homes
M104 S140 ; nozzle to probing temperature — hot enough to be clean, cool enough not to ooze on the bed
G28 ; home all axes (Z homes on the bed with the nozzle)
M190 S{bedTemp:.0f} ; wait for the bed — the mesh is measured hot
M109 S140 ; wait for the probing temperature
G29 ; full-bed auto levelling
M109 S{hotendTemp:.0f} ; nozzle to printing temperature (wait)
endScript:
M400 ; drain the planner queue
G92 E0
G1 E-0.8 F1800 ; retract the tip so it stops oozing (correct in either extrusion mode after G92 E0)
G91
G1 Z2 F900 ; lift clear of the part
G90
M400
M106 P1 S0 ; part fan off
M106 P2 S0 ; aux fan off
M106 P3 S0 ; chamber fan off
M104 S0 ; nozzle off
M140 S0 ; bed off
M220 S100
M221 S100
